svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: How Cortecho works
svg.desc: A person asks a rooted Echo Dot a question. The Echo (Amazon microphones, wake word and speaker, running hassmic from echo-dot-assist, without the Amazon cloud) streams the audio over the encrypted ESPHome API to Cortecho, a Docker container on the same network. Cortecho listens for the end of speech, transcribes, runs an agent with tools and MCP connectors, turns the answer into speech with an OpenAI-compatible API, and the Echo downloads the reply audio over HTTP and plays it. A web UI and an HTTP API manage it; one Cortecho serves every Echo in the house.
